name: Run To Grab Brainrots!
desc:
Welcome to Run To Grab Brainrots 🧠

Run fast so you don't fall!


-How to Play? 🎮
-Run Run over the blocks for brainrots 🏃
-Upgrade your speed and become faster ⚡
-Stay alive and collect many Brainrots! 🛡️
-Upgrade your base to unlock more slots and place extra Brainrots! 🏗️
-Upgrade your Brainrots and get more money! 💸

Your Brainrots earn cash OFFLINE! 💤
Like the game and join the group for FREE 67 BRAINROT! 👍
